text:
anya: Quick convo: prioritize cross-region burst credit broker for Dedicated. Sales says customers need predictable regional bursts during launches.

sam: +1. Two modes: broker (managed credits) or marketplace. Start broker for lower ops.

matt: Runtime concerns: KV cache locality, graceful drain API, routing stability when credits shift. Need a rollback path.

carla: Sales needs SLA language + billing signal. Pilot pricing model? flat credit packs or usage-based? Also refund windows for failed preemptions.

zoe: UX: console should show credits, pending transfers, timers, burn-rate and opt-in toggle. Defaults conservative; expose advanced controls via API.

dinesh: Ops: require audit logs for transfers, per-tenant reclaim API, kill-switch, and alerts for reclaim failures. Add chaos test to runbook.

ops-bot: billing-bot: ticket BILL-2042 created for metering impact.

sam: Pilot gating:
- 48h pilot with no SLA breaches (per-tenant)
- regional_p95 delta <= +15% vs baseline (24h)
- transfer_audit_success = 100% for pilot window
- billing reconciliation error <= 1%

anya: Owners: sam (broker API & pilot design), matt (runtime hooks + canary), zoe (console UX & feature flag), carla (sales/legal offers), dinesh (runbook & alerts). I'll draft roadmap card and open a spec PR.

matt: I'll add canary dashboards and a reclaim chaos test this sprint.

carla: Drafting pilot offer copy and sample SLA clause now; will loop in legal.

anya: Meeting Thurs to finalize pilot customer list and timeline. Thanks everyone.
